reconciliations.note: The idea that the consulting deliverable of the AI age is not a deck but an installable perspective is already established in the perspective as a high-conviction (boulder) claim from March 19 — "instead of a deck, deliver a perspective the whole org can install," with the deck as a derived artifact. What this call adds is (a) **independent validation** of that thesis from a working designer who arrived at it through his own practice, (b) the concrete **design-token ↔ perspective parallel** the graph was explicitly missing, and (c) a **status note**: Tanya has not yet actually delivered an aswritten perspective as a deck-alternative to a consulting client.

This is convergent validation from outside aswritten: a designer independently building extraction → tokens → AI-applied output, and naming "the lens" as the irreducible, defensible core — the same claim aswritten makes about perspective. It grounds the design-token/perspective parallel and the brand-as-AI-identity endpoint with primary-source material, and it flags a concrete, still-open product move: actually delivering a perspective to a consulting client in place of a deck.
